description: Land Acquisition - Kahatapitiya, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Dambara, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific plots of land for public purposes (Ruwanpura Expressway Project), including descriptions of land parcels, locations, claimants, and acquisition procedures. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative matters.
